'''Wintenberry jelly''' was a variant of jelly. It was once carried as cargo by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] during his ownership of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] on an unprofitable run to [[Dilonexa XXIII]].
